def plot_candlestick_with_fibonacci(data, input_date):
    fig = plt.figure(figsize=(17, 10))
    ax = fig.add_axes([0, 0.2, 1, 0.5])
    ax2 = fig.add_axes([0, 0, 1, 0.2])

    # 这里假定数据是一个包含Datetime列的DataFrame，并确保它是Datetime INDEX。
    data['Datetime'] = pd.to_datetime(data['日期'])
    data.set_index('Datetime', inplace=True)

    # 绘制蜡烛图及成交量图
    mpf.plot(
        data=data,
        type="candle",
        ax=ax,
        title=str(data['股票代码'].iloc[0]),
        ylabel="price(￥)",
        style="binance",
        ylabel_lower="volume(shares)",
        mav=(5, 10, 20),  # 移动平均线
        volume=ax2,
    )

    ax.legend(loc='upper left')
    ax.grid(True)

    # 设置日期格式
    ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(mdates.DateFormatter('%Y-%m-%d'))


    # 计算斐波拉契数列
    fibonacci_numbers = [0, 1]
    while fibonacci_numbers[-1] < len(data):
        fibonacci_numbers.append(fibonacci_numbers[-1] + fibonacci_numbers[-2])

    # 将输入日期转换为日期时间对象并找到其在数据中的索引
    input_date_obj = pd.to_datetime(input_date, format='%Y-%m-%d')
    print(input_date_obj)
    input_date_index = data.index.get_loc(input_date_obj)  # 查找最近的日期索引

    # 标注斐波拉契数字
    for fib in fibonacci_numbers:
        if fib + input_date_index < len(data):
            date = data.index[fib + input_date_index]
            close_price = data['Close'].iloc[fib + input_date_index]
            ax.annotate(str(fib), xy=(date, close_price), xytext=(date, close_price + 5),
                        arrowprops=dict(facecolor='black', shrink=0.05), fontsize=8)

    # 将图像保存为字节流
    img_buf = io.BytesIO()
    plt.savefig(img_buf, format='png')
    img_buf.seek(0)
    plt.show(fig)
    plt.close(fig)

    # 将字节流转换为Base64编码字符串
    img_base64 = base64.b64encode(img_buf.read()).decode('utf-8')

    return img_base64

An Overview At a high level, the GitHub Actions flow is this: 1. Some triggering event happens in a GitHub repository. This event is most often associated with a unique SHA1 (Secure Hashing Algorithm 1) value and a Git reference that resolves to an SHA1 value (a ref), such as a branch. But it may also be an event in GitHub that is not an update to a ref. An example would be a com‐ ment made in a pull request or an issue being updated. 15 2. A dedicated directory in the repository (.github/workflows) is searched for work‐ flow files that are coded to respond to the event type. Many events can also include additional qualifiers. For example, a workflow can be set up to be trig‐ gered only when a push operation happens on the branch named main. 3. Corresponding workflows are identified, and new runs of the matching work‐ flows are triggered. The workflow object is the key piece here. A GitHub Actions workflow is a set of code that defines a sequence and set of steps to execute, similar to a script or a program. The file itself must be coded in YAML format and stored in the /.github/ workflows directory.

    def __init__(self, tensor_file):
        # Load the preprocessed tensor
        extensions = ['.png','.jpeg','.jpg']
